query:
UPDATE proposals SET status = 'building', build_owner_user_id = $1,
                    last_reconciled_revision_seq = latest_revision_seq,
                    pending_reconcile = false,
                    reconciled_at = now(),
                    updated_at = to_char(now() at time zone 'utc', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.MS"Z"')
             WHERE id = $2
